company.description: Squatwolf is an activewear and fitness apparel company that develops and sells gym wear, workout clothing, and fitness accessories for men and women through e-commerce platforms and selected retail locations. Its product range includes training t-shirts, leggings, shorts, hoodies, joggers, sports bras, bags, socks, and other athletic accessories.
